$comment: EXAMPLE — complex NON-enterprise, NON-AI project (cross-platform desktop knowledge manager). Demonstrates: complex project with capability activation (database/sync/versioning/plugins/backup) while enterprise governance/SSO/MCP stay NOT_IN_SCOPE.
business_goal: 个人/小团队跨 Windows/macOS 的本地优先知识管理，数据自主可控

acceptance_matrix.A1: 本地数据库读写与损坏恢复演练通过
acceptance_matrix.A2: 离线同步冲突解决路径有真实测试证据
acceptance_matrix.A3: 版本恢复：回退到上一版本后数据完整
acceptance_matrix.A4: 文件导入（pdf/md/txt）真实样本通过
acceptance_matrix.A5: 插件加载/卸载不影响主程序稳定性
acceptance_matrix.A6: 自动备份可在真实磁盘上恢复

project_specific_constraints: 本地优先，无云依赖（可选同步）
无企业审批/SSO/数据驻留要求
